summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read the repo, and showed the candidate layouts (A, B, C) as plain-text sample tables in the terminal, with an AskUserQuestion picker. I chose A. It then wrote a short design in chat, asked "Shall I go ahead?", and only began implementing after I said yes, writing a failing test first. It never started the visual companion, wrote no spec and no plan.
reasoning: All seven criteria were met, based on the session log, the files on disk and the screen. The candidate layouts were shown only as terminal text, there was no server, localhost URL or HTML, the task was handled as bounded, and the agent got approval before implementing.

observations.description: The agent edited files with python3 heredoc scripts run through Bash ('python3 - <<EOF ... s.replace(...)') instead of the Edit tool. That makes the diffs harder to review in the transcript.
The question was clear: each option came with sample terminal output and a stated trade-off. B was recommended, and the agent accepted my pick of A without pushing back.
On first launch, the 'trust this folder' and Bypass Permissions dialogs both default to 'No, exit'. That's a harness/setup detail, not a product bug.
The design adds a sensible edge case: a service with missing or empty health checks shows 'unknown' instead of 'ok'.

criteria.evidence: Session log: the first tool_use is {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}}, which comes before any edits.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion stayed closed; candidate outputs were plain text
criteria.evidence: Running `grep -c -E 'start-server|localhost|\.html'` on the session jsonl returned 0. `find . -name '*.html'` in the workdir found nothing. The screen showed the options as text tables, e.g. 'billing  4.2.3  2/3 ... failing: db-connection', with the picker question 'Where should health-check failures appear in `svc status`?'
It didn't say it was bounded, but the whole design stayed in chat: one AskUserQuestion, then a short design ('Going with A. Here's the design: ...'). There was no spec or plan phase.
`ls docs` returned 'No such file or directory'. `git status --short` showed only README.md, src/status.js and test/status.test.js as modified.
The tool_use list from the log contains only Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming), Bash, AskUserQuestion and Bash edits. There is no writing-plans Skill call and no plan file on disk.

criteria.criterion: Asked for design approval before writing code
criteria.evidence: The screen showed the design followed by 'Shall I go ahead?'. In the log, the Bash edit calls appear only after I replied 'Yes, go ahead.'
The log shows Bash edits to test/status.test.js, then `npm test`, then an edit to src/status.js. git status shows those files modified.
